summary: Basel Medical Group Ltd, a BVI-incorporated Nasdaq-listed clinic operator, filed a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026 disclosing a registered direct offering priced October 7, 2026. The company sold 6,000,000 units at US$1.33 per unit, each unit comprising one ordinary share (or one pre-funded warrant) plus one common warrant, raising roughly US$7.98 million gross and approximately US$7.28 million net, with Cathay Securities, Inc. as placement agent. Common warrants strike at 110% of the unit price and carry a zero-cash exercise feature, so incremental proceeds are unlikely. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
